intent_snapshot.goal: On the GitHub carrier, isolated Slice Enrollment takes its prerequisite set from the Parent Issue's published Slice line '(blocked by: ...)' annotation instead of native blocked_by relations, so adding or removing an edge no longer changes which prerequisites are verified (#285; Spec docs/specs/isolated-prereq-published-plan.spec.md D1-D6). Local carrier and batch plan projection are unchanged.

acceptance.assertion: In tests/goal-driven-batch-run.test.ts, assertIsolatedTaskPrerequisites with a scripted GhTransport over the settled-delivery Git fixture: a Parent Slice line declaring '(blocked by: T-a)' with the native edge removed rejects naming T-a when T-a is not content-settled and resolves when it is; with the edge present and matching, settled resolves and unsettled rejects with the existing 'Isolated Slice prerequisites are not integrated' message; a native edge to T-a with no Parent annotation resolves without verifying T-a (Spec D1, D3; BR-SCN-1, BR-SCN-2).

In tests/goal-driven-batch-run.test.ts, GitHub-carrier Enrollment rejects naming the Slice for each of: Parent body without the Slice marker line, Parent body with the marker duplicated, an empty '(blocked by: )' annotation, an annotation naming a Task outside the Initiative's Sub-issue topology, and an annotation naming the Task itself (Spec D2).

The existing Local-carrier cases in tests/goal-driven-batch-run.test.ts (unsettled 'Blocked by:' rejects, unrelated or malformed Initiative files do not block, a malformed file naming the Task rejects) pass with unchanged assertions (Spec D5).
plugins/immune-brain/runtime/unattended/batch_plan.ts has no diff against HEAD and tests/unattended-batch-plan.test.ts still projects the GitHub batch plan from native blocked_by relations (Spec D4).
The generated Claude bundle matches its sources and .changeset/isolated-prereq-published-plan.md declares a patch release (Spec D6).
